residual_risks: The upstream-square control uses a separately compiled materialized mean graph, not an injection into the fused production helper.
The closed MPSGraph power implementation and exact internal approximation mechanism are not established.
The prior constant-exponent power negative covers that formulation only; Torch feeds an exponent tensor through its scalar wrapper.
This fixed-input localization changes no production arithmetic and qualifies neither S1280 prefix parity, performance nor generated video.
Companion bridge.o and metal_mps_command_chain.o have pinned bytes but opaque pre-existing source ancestry; this is not a hermetic build.
Memory limits are sampled, with file-backed bytes an estimate of reclaimability; they are not an instantaneous peak guarantee or reservation.
MiniQuad reviewers share lineage/context and are correlated, not independent model provenance.

refresh.operation: Reauthenticate all byte bindings and rerun the isolated official/native/expression controls with fresh names and current admission.
refresh.failure_policy: Reopen the dependent localization claim; do not silently substitute fixtures or broaden tolerances.
